description: Master dimension of commercial and cargo airlines, callsigns, alliances, and active flags.
Global commercial airline alliances (SkyTeam, Star Alliance, oneworld).
Global aerodromes, geographic coordinates, runway elevation, and city linkage.
Airport passenger terminals, jet bridge boarding gates, and remote aircraft stands.
Physical airframes, manufacturer MSN, seat maps, engine models, and maintenance cycles.
Published timetable schedules, repeating days of week, and route pairings.
Operational flight instances, block times, delay minutes, fuel burn, and passenger counts.
Passenger reservations, fare basis, cabin assignment, loyalty tier, and check-in channel.
IATA Resolution 753 baggage touchpoints (Drop, Security, ULD Load, Ramp, Reclaim).
Live ADS-B state vectors (altitude, groundspeed, track heading, latitude, longitude).
Versioned rerouting business rules: MCT/buffer thresholds, voucher policy, partner priority, and required approver role.
Computed misconnect-risk checks: buffer minutes against MCT, which rules were evaluated, and the alternate ultimately selected for at-risk connecting passengers.
